videos.headline: Siraj to Anderson, out Bowled!! Knocks over the off stump!!! The Indian players erupt. Good length ball from round the wicket, with Siraj changing the angle, gets it to straighten past the outside edge. And Siraj is off, dashing away after picking up one of the stumps. Anderson b Siraj 0(3)

Siraj to Buttler, out Caught by Pant!! India are jubilant. After batting pretty well for pretty long, Buttler's poked at one away from the body. Back of a length outside off, straightens a touch and Buttler feathers it to the keeper. Just one more wicket left and now India can smell the victory. Buttler c Pant b Siraj 25(96) [4s-3]

Bumrah to Robinson, out Lbw!! Wow, this variation has completely bamboozled Robinson. A slower ball pitched up and hitting Robinson on the back leg. It's from round the wicket though. Has it pitched in line? India have taken the review. Whoa it has pitched in line. Absolutely sensational slower ball from Bumrah, creating something when nothing's happening. Robinson just didn't see it coming. He would've expected it to be short again. It pitches on a length around leg, goes past the inside edge in defence and thuds the back leg in front of middle and off. Three reds. Robinson lbw b Bumrah 9(35)

Siraj to Sam Curran, out Caught by Pant!! Edged and gone! It's a King Pair for Sam Curran at Lord's. Crazy scenes in the Indian camp as Siraj runs off and his teammates mob him. It's that away-going uncomfrotable angle from Siraj to the left-hander. Curran hanging back to a fullish delivery, Siraj has been bowling scrambled seam to get that away movement too. No chance for a left-hander to survive if you are not on the front foot. Kohli then shushes the crowd. Sam Curran c Pant b Siraj 0(1)

Siraj to Moeen Ali, out Caught by Kohli!! Should have been out four times last over. Finally finds the edge and importantly the captain clings on at first slip. Before this ball Kohli hinted to Siraj about making Mo push at the ball to find the edge. Siraj has done exactly that. Was a fullish delivery angling across. Mo was never really comfortable playing that angle from Siraj and he got a healthy edge. Didn't play with soft hands, so carried quite comfortably to the Indian captain. Moeen Ali c Kohli b Siraj 13(42) [4s-2]

Bumrah to Root, out Caught by Kohli!! Root has been uprooted! Look at Kohli who has taken the catch and he's celebrating it with a sprint. The decibels in the stadium have gone a couple of notches up. And it's Bumrah who has weaved his magic yet again. Played a pivotal innings earlier in the day, and he has claimed his second wicket of the day - the most important scalp. Hits this back of a length delivery outside off and forces the batsman to poke at it. An outside edge is induced and Kohli in the cordon at first slip makes sure to latch on this regulation catch. Lovely stuff! Root c Kohli b Bumrah 33(60) [4s-5]

Ishant to Bairstow, out Lbw!! Huuuge roar from the Indian team and their fans in the stands. Michael Gough has hardly put a foot wrong. Kohli wasn't really sure and chanced his arm there with a review and boy, India have a wicket with the last ball before tea. Ishant has been rewarded for some brilliant discipline. He's kept the ball close to off stump and swung it back and also got it hold its line on occasions. Bairstow played outside the line of this length ball that cut back in to catch the front pad on the kneeroll. Ump Gough thought height was an issue and it wasn't a straightforward call to be fair to him. India reviewed and got their fourth wicket. Bairstow lbw b Ishant 2(24)

Ishant to Haseeb Hameed, out Lbw!! End of Haseeb Hameed's show. Very good decision from umpire Michael Gough again. The bat was close to the ball, but he was spot on. What a bowling change this by Virat. Got Ishant in. They were anyway looking to bring the ball back into the right-hander. And that's Ishant's natural angle too. Does have the wrist for the inducker. Hameed hangs back to this nip-backer and misses. The bat may have been obstructed by the pad as he tried to defend. But he was playing down the wrong line in the first place. The ball escapes the inside edge and hit him just above the kneeroll on the back pad. Impact in line with middle. Hitting top of leg says ball-tracker. Umpire's call on the review and England retain the review. Haseeb Hameed lbw b Ishant 9(45)
England 2 wickets. Shami follows Bumrah s footsteps, Sibley departs
Bumrah gives India a perfect start, Burns goes for 0

Robinson to Pant, out Caught by Buttler!! England have the big wicket they wanted today. Good length ball going across off, maybe could've been left alone. But Pant presses forward to defend and nicks it through. There wasn't exaggerated movement off the seam. Just went with the angle nicely. Pant's disappointed as he walks back and now it's anyone's guess what India's tail has to offer. Pant c Buttler b Robinson 22(46) [4s-1]

Moeen Ali to Jadeja, out Bowled!! England spinning a web. It is familiar foe for the Indians. Mo is at it again. That turned ever so slightly and took the off-pole. Jadeja got squared up a little to fend it but failed to get bat. The ball turned enough and took the off-stump for Jadeja to be sent back. India in serious trouble now. It is getting dark out there and India's chances looking bleak as well. Jadeja b Moeen Ali 3(5)

Moeen Ali to Rahane, out Caught by Buttler!! Tame dismissal! That was the slider, Rahane pokes at it in a lame manner to edge it to the keeper. Gough raises his finger this time and there is dismay for Rahane. End of a fantastic knock but on a poor note. India suddenly find themselves in a little bit of a disconcerting situation. Mo used the slope and managed to drift it through. He had beaten Rahane earlier in the over and managed to catch the elusive edge this time. The half horizontal blade didn't help. Rahane paying the price of hanging back to Moeen's not-so-short deliveries. Wasn't willing to play off the front foot for a long while and perishes. Rahane c Buttler b Moeen Ali 61(146) [4s-5]

Mark Wood to Pujara, out Caught by Root!! And that was a disconcerting delivery which picks Pujara. That landed on the back of a length spot, kicked up and Pujara couldn't keep it down. The ball rose up suddenly to leave Pujara with no chance at fending it away. Root at second slip had an easy take. A wicket against the run of play for the hosts. The extra pace from Mark Wood helped. Pujara went back and across, covered the line but the spring on that was too much for the batter to deal with and it took the glove. Needed something as brute as this to defeat Pujara's doggedness today. Cruel game this, Cricket! Pujara c Root b Mark Wood 45(206) [4s-4]

Sam Curran to Kohli, out Caught by Buttler!! Sam Curran.. The man. Look at him run away. Dreadful, really dreadful poke away from the body. That ball wouldn't even have touched 7th stump. Kohli looked good, but his habit of lunging and playing away from the body has drowned him yet again. Was a full delivery wide of off stump, Kohli on the front foot and pushing at it. Wasn't even driving and looking for runs, which makes the dismissal look even more worse. Bumrah, Siraj and the bowlers would be talking to themselves.. Mate we run in and bowl close outside off stump but don't find the edges at times. But you poke at one that's acres away and nick off. This applies to other batters too. England having a great morning! Replay shows the ball may have hinted at shaping back in and then nipped back, but it's that huge bat-pad gap that's forced the dismissal. Kohli c Buttler b Sam Curran 20(31) [4s-4]

Mark Wood to Rohit, out Caught by Moeen Ali!! Rohit falls off the pull shot again! Oh dear. He pulled one into the stands a couple of balls earlier, but now he stands staring at the toe-end of his bat after hitting this to deep backward square. This bouncer was higher than the one that disappeared for six. Rohit isn't in control. It goes flat to Mooen Ali who makes no mistake. And India have lost both openers with the score effectively 0. Rohit c Moeen Ali b Mark Wood 21(36) [4s-2 6s-1]

Mark Wood to Rahul, out Caught by Buttler!! A big roar from Wood as Rahul nicks behind. Just a little tentative in defence here against the extra pace. And the plan to bring Wood in early has come together nicely for Root. Back of a length delivery angled in towards off, it straightens just a touch and that's enough for the outside edge. Rahul, who's been so good for India at the top, has fallen early and now the pressure's on the middle-order who haven't been at their best. India still in deficit. Rahul c Buttler b Mark Wood 5(30)

Shami to Anderson, out Bowled!! Anderson is knocked over off the final ball of the day. He goes "noooo" as he throws his head back. For all his troubles he has a duck. Cruel, cruel game. Full ball angled in from round the wicket, straightens a touch to beat the edge as Anderson pushes at it. Crashes into off stump. Anderson b Shami 0(16)

Ishant to Sam Curran, out Caught by Rohit!! The Ishant versus Ashwin debated has been settled! That was a lovely length delivery, Sam Curran had to play at it and he did push at it to edge it. The slip fielder didn't lose any sweat to take it. The languid Sharma as he is with the bat takes it with ease. Ishant on a hat-trick out of nowhere. His persistence against the left-handers has paid dividends. Curran has been a nightmare for the Indians but not today. India right back in this. England are still 23 adrift. Sam Curran c Rohit b Ishant 0(1)

Ishant to Moeen Ali, out Caught by Kohli!! The persistence outside off has paid off. His nagging lines outside off has induced an edge and the slip fielder has done well to pouch one low. Kohli did well to grab that despite the ball dying on him. Lovely length delivery, nibbled away, Moeen Ali poked at it and got the edge for it to fly low. The fielder there did really well to grab it. India get a much needed wicket and Mo would be gutted as he looked so good out there. Moeen Ali c Kohli b Ishant 27(72) [4s-4]

Ishant to Buttler, out Bowled!! Ishant roarrrs. He really roars looking at the skies. He badly wanted a wicket for all the work he has put in. Such a delightful dismissal to watch. Fullish, drawing the batter forward, sucking him into the drive but cunningly nipping the ball back to beat the inside edge on the drive and hit top of off. Yes, top of off. Hitting top of off with movement/spin is a dream for any bowler. Lord's helping Ishant with the slope too. Buttler b Ishant 23(42) [4s-4]

Siraj to Bairstow, out Caught by Kohli!! India's short ball barrage has worked. This is ordinary from Bairstow. The new ball is only a couple of overs away, and India's plan was to go short till they get there, which would dry up the runs and also pose a different challenge for these two. Bairstow falls for it. Round the wicket, Siraj changed the angle before this delivery, banged it in short into the body. Bairstow takes it on, he isn't in control and it pops up off the glove to first slip. Bairstow c Kohli b Siraj 57(107) [4s-7]

Shami to Rory Burns, out Lbw!! The finger goes up. It looked a bit high in real time, and Burns has reviewed immediately. Back of a length, nipping in from round the wicket and trapping Burns on the crease. It's hit above the knee roll. It's three reds though. Crashing into the top of middle and leg. Shami has the breakthrough for India as Burns goes one short of a fifty. The impact might have been above the knee roll, but Burns was in the crease and there wasn't a lot of distance for the ball to travel. Has to be said, a really good decision from umpire Illingworth. Rory Burns lbw b Shami 49(136) [4s-7]

Siraj to Haseeb Hameed, out Bowled!! Ohhh knocked him over first ball. They replaced Zak Crawley with Hameed, who now walks back for a golden duck. Siraj is on a hat-trick. Bit of a strange dismissal that. Siraj bowled this full and on the off stump, looked like an easy forward defence because it didn't do much in the air or off the pitch. Hameed seems to have played down the wrong line and got beatnen on the outside edge. Siraj does bowl with that wobbly seam, somehow got it to sneak past the bat. Haseeb Hameed b Siraj 0(1)

Siraj to Sibley, out Caught by Rahul!! Oh Dom Sibley not again! Shami had him caught at short mid-wicket off a leading edge at Trent Bridge, now Siraj has him at Lord's. Look at that sheepish smile and celebration from Siraj. He knows he's got very lucky here. Was nothing but a freebie down leg-side, Sibley went for the flick, but was too careful because of close in catches on the on-side in front of square and Rahul stretched to his right to pouch the ball. The start India wanted. Sibley c Rahul b Siraj 11(44) [4s-1]

Siraj to Sibley, out Caught by Rahul!! Oh Dom Sibley not again! Shami had him caught at short mid-wicket off a leading edge at Trent Bridge, now Siraj has him at Lord's. Look at that sheepish smile and celebration from Siraj. He knows he's got very lucky here. Was nothing but a freebie down leg-side, Sibley went for the flick, but was too careful because of close in catches on the on-side in front of square and Rahul stretched to his right to pouch the ball. The start India wanted. Sibley c Rahul b Siraj 11(44) [4s-1]
Moeen Ali to Jadeja, no run, flatter delivery on the stumps, Jadeja rocks back and punches towards cover

Anderson to Rahane, out Caught by Root!! Edged and gone! India off to an abysmal start. Just a tame flail outside off and the ball took the edge for the man at slip to take a low catch. India are imploding out of nowhere. First ball of the day for Rahane turns out to be his last. His poor returns also don't show any improvements. India's tail now is only a wicket away from being exposed. Rahane c Root b Anderson 1(23)

Robinson to Rahul, out Caught by Sibley!! That is a bizzare way to get out. A buffet ball has consumed Rahul. Pitched up outside off, Rahul goes for that high elbow drive and fails to keep it down. The man at cover pouches it and there is indefinite glee on the faces of the England players. Just sheer bad luck. India jolted early. He had a daddy hundred there for the taking but has missed out. The one-day kind of a field setting has paid dividends. Rahul c Sibley b Robinson 129(250) [4s-12 6s-1]

Robinson to Kohli, out Caught by Root!! This time Kohli's edge has carried to the slips. Another delivery he could've left outside off. Good length ball around the fifth stump, Kohli fiddles with it looking to defend but the ball just holds its line a touch to take the edge. Carries nicely around shin height to first slip where Root moves low to his right for a safe catch. It's a boost for England towards the end of the day. Kohli c Root b Robinson 42(103) [4s-3]

Anderson to Pujara, out Caught by Bairstow!! Hangs his bat outside off and is a goner! Poor poke outside off and the third slip fielder buckets it. Pujara's dry run continues. That left the batter late but Pujara had no business playing at that delivery which was outside off. A lame shot to get out. India frittering away the advantage a little as the murky conditions continue to be beneficial for England. And this man! This legend continues to wreak havoc. Pujara c Bairstow b Anderson 9(23) [4s-1]

Anderson to Rohit, out Bowled!! The outswinger on the previous delivery set this dismissal up. Rohit wasn't ready for the in-ducker which decked in late after landing on the seam. That impeccable seam positioning and some shrewd thinking from England's talisman has brought about a wicket against the run of play. End of a fine knock from Rohit where he hardly put any foot wrong. But this time committed a little early and couldn't account for the late inward movement, the ball hit the back leg and hit top of off stump. The overseas hundred will have to wait. Rohit b Anderson 83(145) [4s-11 6s-1]
